title: Art (art.json)
description: Pictures in pixels that other entries use by id, e.g. a character's 'art'. One picture can serve many characters.

$schema.description: Path to this file's schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

art.description: A picture in pixels. Each letter in 'rows' is one pixel in the palette's colour for that letter; a space or '.' is see-through. Two pixel rows share one line of text (half-block characters), so 24 rows take 12 lines. Without colour only the shape shows. Characters show theirs on the character screen, in conversations and in fights, in the UI pack's art zone (24 by 24 in the default UI pack), centred; a larger picture is cut to the zone.

rows.description: Pixel rows, top to bottom, all the same length; at most 32 by 32.

palette.description: Pixel letter to colour, by its name in the pack's palette.
